name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank account.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria for institutional landowners and high income tax payers).
documents_required: Land Ownership Documents (Record of Rights / Pahani / 7/12)
verified_by: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana) - Current Season
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance covering yield losses due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, pests). Premium capped at 1.5% for Rabi crops and 2% for Kharif crops.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas (both loanee and non-loanee farmers).

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri Scheme
benefits: ₹10,000 per hectare incentive directly credited via DBT to farmers cultivating minor millets (Ragi, Foxtail, Little millet, etc.).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Karnataka cultivating notified millet varieties registered on the FRUITS portal.
verified_by: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefits: Free comprehensive soil nutrient testing (macro and micronutrients) with customized crop-wise fertilizer recommendations.
eligibility: All operational agricultural landholders across India.
last_date: Open Year-Round at Block RSK / Soil Testing Labs
